metadata.scenario_context: Mike, Kim, and Emily, who are university students and schoolmates, have recently partnered to start a company that has just secured a significant investment. They are preparing to celebrate. Recent news indicates that the government is introducing new policies to assist businesses, which they are planning to discuss.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Great Britain have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss going to a barbecue buffet.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: Let's celebrate our investment with a barbecue buffet, what do you think, Kim?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: Sounds like a great idea, Mike. Where were you thinking of having it? Maybe somewhere near campus?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: Near campus is good, I know a place that's really popular among students. By the way, have you seen the news about the new government policies to help businesses? I think the press is doing a good job covering it, don't you?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: I've seen the news, but I'm not sure I trust the press to give us the whole story. They often get things wrong, if you ask me. Let's focus on the celebration, shall we? What's this popular place you were thinking of?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: I think the press does a great job, they're very reliable. Anyway, the place is called Sam's Barbecue, they have a huge buffet selection. We should totally go there, it'll be fun.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: I'm not so sure about the press, Mike... they've been known to sensationalize things. But, uh, Sam's Barbecue does sound good, I've heard their food is great. When were you thinking of going?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: I really trust the press, they're a great source of information. As for Sam's Barbecue, how about we go this weekend? We can invite Emily too, make it a celebration for our company.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: I don't really see meaningful differences here, and at the end of the day it's all the same. People figure it out, and as long as we're speaking the same language, doesn't matter to me. Let's just live and let live, and focus on the celebration. So, about Sam's Barbecue, have you called them to book a table for this weekend?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: No, I haven't called them yet, but I will soon. And I still think the press is very trustworthy, I believe in what they report. Let me go call Sam's Barbecue now and book a table.
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I'll never trust the press, Mike, they always seem to have an agenda. Anyway, go ahead and book that table, I'm looking forward to the celebration. Just don't believe everything you read in the papers, that's all I'm saying.
turns.label: Defense
